caseNameFull: Johnson v. Union Pacific Railroad Co.
attorneys: William D. Donnelly was on the motion for Johnson et ux., petitioners. Bryan P. Leverich for respondent.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The Pacific Fruit Express Co. is dismissed as a party petitioner herein per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.
